messages:
Alex: quick heads-up — we need p4d / p5 / g5 quota increases in eu-central-2 and ap-southeast-3 for the new partner org (org-id: org-primus). Main asks: per-region accelerator ceiling (+40 p5, +20 p4d, +80 g5), AZ spread across at least 2 AZs, and a SNAT IP pool bump for the NAT gateways in the onboarding VPCs. This is blocking cluster provisioning for their Dedicated pilot.
Maria: can you paste the exact account IDs and subnets we'll be requesting quotas against? also add desired burst window (we should distinguish steady vs burst).
Alex: account IDs: 123456789012 (dev), 234567890123 (staging), 345678901234 (prod). Subnets: prod-subnet-a, prod-subnet-b (eu-central-2a/2b), staging-subnet-a (ap-southeast-3a). Steady: 20 p5 / 4 p4d / 40 g5; Burst: additional +20 p5 / +16 p4d / +40 g5 for 30m during rollout. SNAT: need +60 ephemeral IPs in eu-central-2 NAT pool and +40 in ap-southeast-3.
Kevin: fyi, az-spread requirement means we need ENI/IPs per AZ bumped too — that's usually quota "Elastic Network Interfaces" and possibly IPv4 address quota on the subnets. I'll add those numbers: ENI +120 across eu-central-2, +80 across ap-southeast-3.
Maria: I'll open the AWS Support quota case. Alex — can you confirm whether we want dedicated reserved capacity (Committed Dedicated) for p5 in prod or just on-demand for now? committed would need procurement signoff.
Alex: start with on-demand quota bump for pilot. We'll evaluate reserved if sustained usage after 2 weeks. Cost note: expected monthly delta if sustained: ~ $150k for the requested prod steady baseline. I'll add that to the case.
Kevin: I'll prepare a quick terraform plan to pre-create the extra NAT GW configs and update our subnet IP allocation doc. Tagging DeployBot to stage a rollout window.
DeployBot: scheduled rollout window created: 2024-08-22 02:00-05:00 UTC (can be updated).
Maria: AWS Support replied with a preliminary ticket id case-2024-08-17-4098-xyz, asking for justification + architecture diagram + list of instance types and quotas per AZ. I attached the spreadsheet. Can someone upload a short diagram?
Alex: uploaded a simple VPC/AZ diagram to the ticket and added the steady/burst table. Also included fallback policy: if any AZ quota not granted, we fallback to g5.xlarge pool in that AZ and route low-priority jobs there.
AWS Support: thanks — we can expedite eu-central-2 but ap-southeast-3 will need account entitlements validated (may take ~72h). Please provide the billing owner contact for prod account 345678901234.
Maria: billing contact is finance+infra@redwood.com (cc: sarah.finance). I've replied to AWS.
Kevin: once quotas land I'll update autoscaler profiles to respect AZ weights and SNAT pool limits; will also add a temporary routing rule to avoid the undersupplied AZs.
Alex: great. action items: Maria — follow up with AWS until quotas confirmed; Kevin — update infra PR and autoscaler; me — confirm cost + procurement if we move to reserved. We'll reconvene once AWS updates the case. :thumbsup:
